_comment: Bundled fallback copy of the MeatPi device catalog. The living document is published at https://github.com/meatpiHQ/meatpi-devices and fetched at runtime; keep this copy in sync when cutting releases. Reserved slugs (wican, wican_usb, wican_pro, meatpi) are extend-only: entries here may add sensors, while identity, capabilities, and firmware matching stay in code.
